params.subtitle: DeepSeek-AI — restoring identity mapping on top of Hyper-Connections

params.title: Residual Connection  —  identity mapping is the whole point

beats.caption: ResNet: x_{l+1} = x_l + F(x_l, W_l). Recursing gives x_L = x_l + Σ F(x_i, W_i).

params.title: Hyper-Connections (HC)  —  widen the residual stream, add learnable mixing

beats.caption: Stream width n×C; H^res, H^pre, H^post are learnable — identity mapping is now broken

params.formula: x_{l+1} = H^{\text{res}}_l \, x_l + (H^{\text{post}}_l)^{\top} F(H^{\text{pre}}_l \, x_l, W_l)
params.title: HC single-layer propagation

bullets: Identity mapping property is lost across deep stacks
Average signal intensity is no longer conserved
Plus: extra memory access overhead per layer

params.title: mHC  —  project H matrices onto a constrained manifold ℳ

beats.caption: Manifold projection restores identity mapping while keeping HC's expressivity

bullets: Kernel fusion to cut memory traffic
Selective recomputing to lower activation memory
Overlap manifold projection with DualPipe communication
End result: stable, scalable, no overhead vs vanilla HC
